connection: per-call sqlite3.connect via get_connection() helper (sqlite3 stdlib)
queries: INSERT INTO orders; per-item INSERT INTO order_items executed inside a loop; SELECT COUNT(*) for the customer's total order count
transactions: single transaction per checkout via conn.commit() after the inserts
n_plus_one: yes: N separate item inserts for N items, plus a separate count query right after the order insert

optimization_targets.description: Replace the loop of per-item INSERTs with a single batched executemany insert; keep the customer order-count lookup as a separate query

notes: Checkout must keep the order status, item rows, returned order id, and customer total order count identical to the original behavior
